scope: Timed Payload delayed translated contact, persistent entity life guard and explicit unavailable-target policy

sources.conflict: Foundry share .5 conflicts with Compendium/Clarity .55. Delay .6 agrees.

sources.notes: Official inventory page describes projectiles attached to enemies exploding after a delay. This establishes attachment intent, not the detailed translation, death, missing-target or rotation policies.

policies: Reference feet position and target/life/dimension are captured before direct damage. At deadline resolve that same life and translate the original contact. The observation includes alive. No implicit bone rotation or scale.
A dead but present body may supply position. Living primary receives the full blast once; other living non-allied targets are queried near the translated contact at detonation.
Missing target at deadline emits a diagnostic, closes the group and retires the blast. It does not silently use original impact or current owner as a substitute.
Block contact uses the recorded surface even if block contents change. Physical-world/unload policies and original-game semantics need independent validation.
One contact damage group lives for one second and closes after the .6-second blast or diagnostic branch. This is explicit consumer policy, not cycle suppression.

Source damage snapshots, radius/mode/delay query results, target identity and original contact survive detached scheduling and domain checkpoint restoration. A physical projectile across full server restart is not proved.
Test radius3 and linear radial shape are synthetic explicit providers; no unknown radius default. B10/P2/ammo/fire rate are synthetic.

Entity UUID and numeric ID are insufficient to distinguish respawn. Persist native life in LivingEntity NBT; ordinary load and dimension copies retain it, player restoreFrom(false) rotates it, restoreFrom(true) retains it. This is host policy, not an assertion of all original-game attachment behavior.

Direct and primary delayed snapshot damage use a life guard again at the actual write boundary. Mismatch returns FAILED without damage facts or buff consumption. Other neighbors are selected at explosion time and do not inherit the primary life reference.

Reference resolution is not a termination subscription. The same life returning to the original dimension can match again. Last-known detach location, permanent retirement notifications, unload coordination and same-object custom revival remain open.
remaining: Original radius, radial interpolation, flinch/stagger, precision rounding and source/target sampling calibration
